title: Navel_Rock
lead_summary:
Navel Rock is an optional island that can only be reached after obtaining the Navel Ticket from Chuck and taking the ship from Boon Island's dock.
At the peak is a Static Encounter with a fused Ho-oh/Lugia.

items.name: PP Max
items.location_details: West Side when starting to climb.

items.name: Sacred Ash
items.location_details: West Side after the PP Max.

items.name: Max Elixir
items.location_details: East Side when Fearow start roaming.
